text_block_list.text:
The Takamatsunomiya Kinen had finally 
arrived. Inside the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Curren-senpai! Looking forward to today!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Same here! Thanks for accepting the 
project♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
As a hero, I welcome any project that can 
bring cheer to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Even though they said that, I didn't 
really get it. So I just kept posting like 
I always do!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, you were totally awesome! Like 
that episode, 'Run, Biko Pegasus! For 
Justice!' ...That was so much fun♪"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, you mean that—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Justice dwells in the legs of a hero! 
Race through the rough terrain, Biko 
Pegasus!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ‘Yaaaah!!’

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Earth, restored!! Biko Pegasus, returning 
to base!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That was inspired by Carrotman Episode 74, 
'Reclaim the Withered Earth!'

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The editing was super well done!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was just copying Curren-senpai! For 
example—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It's Curren♪ I'm gonna cast a spell on 
everyone♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Tada!♪ Fall in love with Curren, 
everyone!♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ""You l-o-v-e me... right? Ehehe♪""

In the end, Curren Chan went all-in on 
cuteness for the post. She said she had a 
plan, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't really messed with filters or 
effects before... but editing is actually 
pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now that we have so many options to play 
around with, it's way easier to recreate 
Carrotman! All the hero fans loved it too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ... I'm so glad Biko-chan had fun♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! No regrets! But—the real show starts 
now!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Curren-senpai, let me say it again! Let's 
have a great match today!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take down Curren-senpai head-on! 
For the sake of everyone waiting for my 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Umm, does this mean Curren's playing 
Biko-chan's nemesis?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah! T-That's not what I meant...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's okay, I understand♪ Besides, it 
feels right having Curren as a rival."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because Curren only has her eyes on 1st 
place♪ Sorry, Biko-chan, but you're gonna 
have to lose to me."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Waiting for Curren's victory—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —All for Curren!
